__dict__: Read from the assembly's own IL, not from the headless harness: `<Character>PotionPool::GenerateAllPotions` is literally `return <Character>4Epoch.Potions` and `GetUnlockedPotions` returns it only when that one epoch is revealed, while `SharedPotionPool::GetUnlockedPotions` removes the `Potion<N>Epoch.Potions` rows per epoch. `potion_pool_census.json` remains the harness oracle for the Ironclad projection, the rarity roll and the procurement semantics; this file adds only the per-character membership those four other characters never had.

Read from the assembly's own IL. `card_pool_census.json` is the headless-harness oracle and it never recorded the Colorless pool at all, so it cannot say which rows are epoch-gated; `COLORLESS_CARD_IDS` froze the fully-unlocked projection, which is only one profile's answer. `ColorlessCardPool::GenerateAllCards` 0xf11a0 is a literal 65-element `ModelDb.Card<T>()` array whose order is RNG-significant, and `FilterThroughEpochs` 0xf13f4 is the `IsEpochRevealed<Colorless<N>Epoch>` chain that removes fifteen rows, three at each of the five Colorless epochs. The two profile-independent predicates are the per-card `get_MultiplayerConstraint` / `get_CanBeGeneratedInCombat` columns carried here for the partition cross-check.
